t.why: One of the world's top five oil producers. US and Iranian influence overlap, so it must constantly balance between them.
t.rel: Caught between Iran and the United States, where both countries' influence overlaps. It has a Kurdish autonomous region in the north and disputes with Turkey over water and Kurdish militants.
t.korea: A major supplier of crude oil to Korea; Korean builders have constructed a huge new city and industrial plants there.
t.know: The ancient city of Babylon, famous for its Hanging Gardens, is in Iraq and became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2019.
t.etext: Crude oil exports provide most government revenue; even civil servants' salaries are paid from oil money. Power shortages, corruption and old infrastructure are major challenges.
